items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: when Sammy Davis would come in and do a Broadway musical, like Apple Tree, Golden Boy, Mr. Wonderful, I played all of them.

ctx.x: Most of the shows, I was the only black. Eventually they started getting other guys in there, like, when Sammy Davis would come in and do a Broadway musical, like Apple Tree, Golden Boy, Mr. Wonderful, I played all of them. I played them like I was playing in a band. That's what they liked about me, authoritative drumming, not down there trying to show off or nothing. Sit back and play your music. So I enjoyed that period of time, really enjoyed it, although it was tiresome and monotonous. You go in and you do…
Now, did you find much difference in kinds of musicians that worked in the pit orchestras in the shows and the musicians that worked in the many bands that you've worked in?
